_comment: The two films, as data rather than as a document.
One file is the source for BOTH the narration and the camera. The voice is
generated from `say`, and the recorder walks the same list in the same
order, holding each shot for exactly as long as that line takes to speak.
Keeping them apart would mean two scripts drifting out of step, and a film
where the pointer presses Forward while the voice is still on Approvals.
`do` is what the recorder performs. `highlight` is the element the ring is
drawn around while the line is spoken. Both are read by video/record.js.
Voices chosen by the owner on 2026-10-13: en_US-joe-medium (CC0) and
es_ES-davefx-medium (CC0). Both unrestricted - nothing is owed to anybody
for either, which is why they were chosen over better-known voices.
How fast the film goes, in ONE place. These three numbers were in three
different files - the pause was written as 800 in record.js and as 0.8 in
assemble.js - and three copies of a number are three chances for the
picture and the voice to drift apart.
lengthScale is Piper's --length-scale: above 1.0 speaks slower. 1.0 was
the first film, which the owner found too fast to follow.
sentenceSilence is Piper's --sentence-silence: breath BETWEEN sentences,
which is most of what makes a voice sound like a person rather than a
list being read out.
pauseSeconds is the gap the recorder holds, and the silence assemble.js
puts between lines. They must be the same number or the film drifts.

member.title: Jericho Platform — for members

say.en: Jericho is a private market for bulk commodities. It is invitation only, nothing posted here ever appears in public, and there is no way in without an invitation. A member signs in with their own email address and their own password.
say.es: Jericho es un mercado privado de materias primas a granel. Solo se entra por invitación, nada de lo que se publica aquí aparece nunca en público, y no hay forma de entrar sin una invitación. Cada miembro entra con su propio correo electrónico y su propia contraseña.

say.en: This row along the top is the whole platform. Seven buttons, and nothing hidden behind them. We will press them one at a time, and I will show you each button before I press it.
say.es: Esta fila de arriba es toda la Plataforma. Siete botones, y nada escondido detrás de ellos. Los iremos pulsando uno a uno, y le mostraré cada botón antes de pulsarlo.

say.en: Start with this one: Browse. It is the market itself - every offer on the platform, from every other member, in one list. Watch what it opens.
say.es: Empecemos por este: Explorar. Es el mercado en sí: todas las ofertas de la Plataforma, de todos los demás miembros, en una sola lista. Mire lo que abre.

say.en: Look carefully at one row, because this is the part that makes Jericho what it is. You get the grade, the quantity, the terms and the origin. What you do not get is a name, a company, or an email address. And the member who posted it cannot see you either.
say.es: Mire con atención una fila, porque esta es la parte que hace de Jericho lo que es. Tiene el grado, la cantidad, las condiciones y el origen. Lo que no tiene es un nombre, una empresa ni una dirección de correo. Y el miembro que la publicó tampoco puede verle a usted.

say.en: If you are always looking for the same material, this button saves the search. It becomes a standing watchlist, and it tells you how many offers match it right now, so you are not scrolling the market every morning.
say.es: Si siempre busca el mismo material, este botón guarda la búsqueda. Se convierte en una lista de seguimiento permanente, y le dice cuántas ofertas coinciden ahora mismo, para que no tenga que recorrer el mercado cada mañana.

say.en: When one of these offers interests you, this is the button. Notice what it does not say. It does not say contact the seller, because you will never be given the seller. It opens a note to your Operator.
say.es: Cuando una de estas ofertas le interesa, este es el botón. Fíjese en lo que no dice. No dice contactar con el vendedor, porque nunca se le dará el vendedor. Abre una nota para su Operador.

scenes.do: type:#contact-body|Interested in this parcel. Please pass my enquiry to the seller.

say.en: You write it in your own words, in plain language. You do not need a name, an address, or a reference for the other side — the Operator already knows which offer you are asking about.
say.es: Se escribe con sus propias palabras, en lenguaje llano. No necesita un nombre, una dirección ni una referencia de la otra parte: el Operador ya sabe por qué oferta pregunta.

say.en: And Send. This does not reach the other member. It reaches your Operator, who reads it, decides whether it should go, and then passes it on. Nothing on this platform travels between two members on its own.
say.es: Y Enviar. Esto no llega al otro miembro. Llega a su Operador, que lo lee, decide si debe seguir adelante, y entonces lo transmite. Nada en esta Plataforma viaja entre dos miembros por sí solo.

say.en: Replies come back along exactly the same path - through the Operator - and land in here. Mailbox. This one is still empty, because the enquiry has only just been sent and nobody has answered it yet. When they do, there will still be no name on it.
say.es: Las respuestas vuelven por exactamente el mismo camino, a través del Operador, y llegan aquí. Buzón. Este todavía está vacío, porque la consulta acaba de enviarse y nadie la ha contestado aún. Cuando lo hagan, seguirá sin llevar ningún nombre.

say.en: Now the other direction. Everything so far belonged to somebody else; this button, New Listing, is how you put something of your own up. Watch what happens when it is pressed: the form opens, and that form is the only place an offer is ever written.
say.es: Ahora en la otra dirección. Todo lo anterior era de otra persona; este botón, Nueva Oferta, es como usted publica algo suyo. Mire lo que pasa al pulsarlo: se abre el formulario, y ese formulario es el único sitio donde se escribe una oferta.

say.en: The first choice is the simplest one. Are you selling something, or are you looking to buy it? This example is a sell offer, so that is the box that gets ticked.
say.es: La primera elección es la más sencilla. ¿Está vendiendo algo, o está buscando comprarlo? Este ejemplo es una oferta de venta, así que esa es la casilla que se marca.

say.en: Next, what the material actually is. This list is the one your Operator keeps, so everybody on the platform describes the same metal the same way. Here it is copper cathodes.
say.es: Después, qué material es en realidad. Esta lista la mantiene su Operador, así que todo el mundo en la Plataforma describe el mismo metal de la misma manera. Aquí son cátodos de cobre.

say.en: Then how much of it. Five hundred. That is one ordinary parcel, the sort of thing that moves in a single shipment — not a year of production, and not a number meant to impress anybody.
say.es: Luego, cuánto hay. Quinientas. Es una partida corriente, de las que se mueven en un solo envío; no la producción de un año, ni una cifra puesta para impresionar a nadie.

say.en: And the unit those five hundred are counted in. Metric tons, in this case. The list carries barrels and kilograms and dry metric ton units as well, because not everything is weighed the same way.
say.es: Y la unidad en la que se cuentan esas quinientas. Toneladas métricas, en este caso. La lista también incluye barriles, kilogramos y unidades de tonelada métrica seca, porque no todo se mide igual.

say.en: The specification is yours to write freely. This is where the grade goes, and anything a buyer would need to know before asking a single question. Here: London Metal Exchange Grade A.
say.es: La especificación la escribe usted libremente. Aquí va el grado, y todo lo que un comprador necesitaría saber antes de hacer la primera pregunta. Aquí: Grado A de la Bolsa de Metales de Londres.

say.en: The Incoterm says who carries the cost and the risk, and how far. All eleven of them are in this list. This offer is CIF, so cost, insurance and freight are the seller's as far as the port.
say.es: El Incoterm dice quién asume el coste y el riesgo, y hasta dónde. Los once están en esta lista. Esta oferta es CIF, así que coste, seguro y flete son del vendedor hasta el puerto.

say.en: And where the material ships from. Chile, here. If this had been a buy request rather than a sell offer, this very same field would have asked for the destination instead.
say.es: Y desde dónde se envía el material. Chile, en este caso. Si esto hubiera sido una solicitud de compra en vez de una oferta de venta, este mismo campo habría pedido el destino.

say.en: That is the whole form. Now the button that matters: Save Listing. One press, and the offer is on the market — and watch, because the platform takes you straight to your own offers to show you it arrived.
say.es: Eso es todo el formulario. Ahora el botón que importa: Guardar Oferta. Una pulsación, y la oferta está en el mercado; y fíjese, porque la Plataforma le lleva directamente a sus propias ofertas para mostrarle que ha llegado.

say.en: There it is, with a reference number of its own. That number is how your Operator will talk to you about this offer, instead of using your name. From here you can change it, renew it, or withdraw it whenever you want.
say.es: Ahí está, con su propio número de referencia. Ese número es la forma en que su Operador hablará con usted de esta oferta, en lugar de usar su nombre. Desde aquí puede modificarla, renovarla o retirarla cuando quiera.

say.en: Documents, where papers are concerned. You tick which ones you hold, and that is all. Nothing is ever uploaded here. The platform stores no documents at all, which means there is nothing on it that could leak.
say.es: Documentos, cuando se trata de papeles. Se marca cuáles posee, y eso es todo. Aquí nunca se sube nada. La Plataforma no almacena ningún documento, lo que significa que no hay nada en ella que pueda filtrarse.

say.en: And this small pair of buttons in the corner changes the language. One press, and every word on every screen you have just seen changes with it.
say.es: Y este pequeño par de botones de la esquina cambia el idioma. Una pulsación, y cambia con él cada palabra de cada pantalla que acaba de ver.

say.en: So that is all of it. You can offer, you can look, and you can deal — and nobody learns who you are until you decide that they should. That is the whole point of Jericho.
say.es: Y eso es todo. Puede ofrecer, puede mirar y puede negociar; y nadie sabe quién es usted hasta que usted decida que deba saberlo. Ese es el sentido de Jericho.

_comment: Each button is zoomed into BEFORE it is pressed and zoomed back out after,
so the viewer sees which control it was and then what it did. The owner
watched the first film and could not tell what was being pressed.
zoom is the element to fill the screen with; zoomScale how close;
zoomOutAfter pulls back once the action is done, which is how the
consequence gets shown; highlightAfter is the ring for that wider shot.
NO SCENE ZOOMS WHILE THE CONTACT MODAL IS OPEN. #contact-modal is
position:fixed (app.html line 294), and a transform on body makes body the
containing block for fixed children - so zooming would move the modal
rather than magnify it. Those three scenes use the ring alone.
The volumes are deliberately ordinary. The first film offered 25,000 metric
tons of copper cathode, which is a quarter of a billion dollars of metal and
reads as a fantasy to anybody in the trade. 500 metric tons is one parcel.
BROWSE COMES BEFORE POSTING, and that is not a stylistic choice.
get_public_listings() returns every listing including the member's own, and
js/app.js sorts newest first - so an offer the film has just posted lands in
row one, and the contact scene would have been the film enquiring about its
own offer. Browsing first leaves row one genuinely somebody else's, with no
fragile nth-child selector to go wrong.
